key_point: Animal Crossing was born from loneliness
title: Animal Crossing was born from loneliness
caption: Animal Crossing was inspired by its creator feeling alone after moving for work. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #animalcrossing #nintendo

instagram.caption:
Animal Crossing came from a lonely place. Katsuya Eguchi moved to Kyoto to work at Nintendo, far from his family and friends.

He said he wanted to recreate that feeling of spending time with the people you love, even when you are apart.

That is why the game is all about neighbors, letters and visits. It was built to make you feel less alone.

Did Animal Crossing ever get you through a hard time?
